messages:
sophia: Heads-up: this week's release train is scheduled for Fri 09:00 PT. Major items: model onboarding (gpt-open-13b-quant), quant-plugin v2.1, and two small schema migrations for user_metrics. Read on for rollout plan & freeze rules.

release-bot: Release window created: train_id=rt-2026-03-27, start=1770000000, freeze_start=1770003600, freeze_end=1770018000, notify_channel=#eng-releases

leah: Note on schema migrations 1: user_metrics.daily_events adds new nullable column; migration is backwards-compatible but we'll gate it behind a single-DB-connection window. Schedule migration in step 2 of rollout so we can rollback cleanly.

eng-sre: Ops: we'll stagger GPU allocations. EU region will receive canary first (5% traffic) due to recent infra churn. Set autoscale cushion to 20% for two hours post-deploy. Alerts: p99 latency > 600ms OR error_rate > 0.8% triggers severity 2.

devops-bot: Canary plan: steps=[5,20,50,100], step_duration=20m, rollback_thresholds={latency:600,error_rate:0.8}, tags=[eu-first,opt-in-partners]

sam: Reminder: partner opt-in lanes (alpha partners) must be toggled off if any regression. Use `./toggle-partner --id <partner> --off` to opt out quickly. Also, pre-stage metric snapshots: `rdw-metrics snapshot --release rt-2026-03-27`.

qa-team: We'll run the long-chat continuity harness and the rerank stability suite during the first step. Focus areas: token continuity across 5k+ sessions, embedding consistency for rerank tests. ETA for results: 50 mins after step 1 completes.

product: Product approves gated rollout. No UX changes this release; watch for subtle latency regressions on low-memory devices.

sophia: Freeze policy reminder: once canary reaches 50% we enter a 2h soft-freeze (only critical fixes allowed). There's a hard freeze 3h after full rollout for schema migrations to finish. Exceptions require an explicit +1 from Eng Dir.

eng-sre: Rollback play: immediate rollback if p99 spikes or if QA shows token continuity failures. Command for rollback: `./deploy rollback --train rt-2026-03-27 --to-tag v3.2.1 --reason "auto"`. We'll coordinate via #incidents if triggered.

leah: I'll stage the DB migration as a no-op and then flip the column in step 3. If anything blocks, we revert schema toggle and rollback model rollout.

sophia: TL;DR: Fri 09:00 PT, EU-first 5% canary -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%, 20m step windows, QA runs at step 1, 2h soft-freeze at 50%, hard freeze 3h post-rollout. Action owners: sophia (release lead), leah (data), eng-sre (ops), qa-team (tests), sam (partner toggles). Ping me if you need preflight runs. :rocket:
